system.description:
Touch; one closable object (door, chest, book). When anyone other than you opens it, it explodes in a 5ft radius for 1d4 + 1 per level fire damage (max 1d4+15); Reflex halves. It lasts until triggered and is found and disarmed by a Search check vs spell DC. Cannot be triggered by nonliving creatures. Material: gold dust worth 25 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Druid, Magus
